preview.tournamentOverview: Sedgefield Country Club rewards ball-striking over distance, with approach play 8%) and total strokes gained 9%) carrying the heaviest weight. The short, tight layout punishes missed greens and rewards players who convert birdie opportunities efficiently. This final regular-season event sets the FedEx Cup field, making current form critical for playoff positioning.
preview.modelExplainer: Approach play dominates our model at 8%, followed by total SG at 9% and around-the-green work at 2%. Driving accuracy 7%) and bogey avoidance 0%) receive minimal weight, confirming this is an iron-play and scrambling test. Putting 9%) matters less than usual, so we prioritize approach SG and total strokes gained over putting metrics.
preview.pickApproach: We tier bets by model rank versus power rank, targeting players whose SG:APP and SG:Total exceed their overall power ranking. Cameron Young leads our board with elite total SG 574) and strong approach numbers despite a modest power rank. We fade players with inflated power ranks relative to their course-specific ball-striking metrics.

article.title: Wyndham Championship 2026: Model Ranks Young, Matsuyama, Hisatsune at Sedgefield
article.dek: Cameron Young leads the tournament model at 574 SG total while Hideki Matsuyama and Ryo Hisatsune rank second and third for the 141-player field.
article.introduction: The tournament model weights approach-the-green 8%) and SG total 9%) most heavily at Sedgefield Country Club. Cameron Young tops the model at 574 SG total and rank 1, followed by Hideki Matsuyama at 197 SG total and rank 2. Ryo Hisatsune sits third at 238 SG total despite a power rank of 20.

sections.heading: Tournament Overview
sections.body: The Wyndham Championship at Sedgefield Country Club features a 141-player field with course weights favoring SG approach 8%) and SG total 9%). The model ranks Cameron Young first at 574 SG total, Hideki Matsuyama second at 197 SG total, and Ryo Hisatsune third at 238 SG total.

sections.heading: Course Fit
sections.body: Sedgefield rewards approach play and total strokes gained. Cameron Young posts 499 SG approach and 574 SG total. Hideki Matsuyama records 635 SG approach and 197 SG total. Ryo Hisatsune shows 576 SG approach and 238 SG total.

sections.heading: Recent Form and Model Strength
sections.body: Cameron Young leads the model at rank 1 with a power rank of 6. Hideki Matsuyama sits at model rank 2 and power rank 16. Ryo Hisatsune ranks third in the model and 20th in power rank, producing the largest rank gap among the three.

sections.heading: Post-Open Workload
sections.body: All three players recorded zero tracked rounds from The Open Championship and Genesis Scottish Open. Cameron Young, Hideki Matsuyama, and Ryo Hisatsune each carry the classification NO_TRACKED_ROUNDS (0 tracked rounds).

sections.heading: FedExCup Motivation
sections.body: Cameron Young enters at FedExCup rank 3, Hideki Matsuyama at rank 24, and Ryo Hisatsune at rank 42. All three sit safely inside the top 50 with no immediate pressure to climb.

sections.heading: Crossover Research Angles
sections.body: Cameron Young, Hideki Matsuyama, and Ryo Hisatsune each skipped the Scottish Open and rank inside the model's top 10. The model rank versus power rank differential is largest for Ryo Hisatsune (17 spots) and Hideki Matsuyama (14 spots).

sections.heading: Outright Targets
sections.body: Cameron Young (model rank 1, 574 SG total) and Hideki Matsuyama (model rank 2, 197 SG total) are the two outright targets. Both carry zero tracked rounds and top-10 model placement.

sections.heading: Top-10 Targets
sections.body: Cameron Young (model rank 1), Hideki Matsuyama (model rank 2), and Ryo Hisatsune (model rank 3) form the top-10 card. All three show model ranks ahead of power ranks and zero tracked rounds post-Open.

sections.heading: Top-20 Targets
sections.body: The same three players—Cameron Young, Hideki Matsuyama, and Ryo Hisatsune—anchor the top-20 card. Their model ranks (1-2-3) sit well ahead of power ranks (6-16-20).

sections.heading: Data Limitations
sections.body: Weather and tee-time data are unavailable. Workload coverage includes only recorded rounds from The Open Championship and Genesis Scottish Open; opposite-field, DP World Tour, LIV, and other events may be missing.

sections.heading: Final Betting Card
sections.body: Tier 1 (model-supported): Cameron Young outright/top-5/top-10/top-20. Tier 2 (model-supported): Hideki Matsuyama outright/top-5/top-10/top-20. Tier 3 (model-supported): Ryo Hisatsune top-10/top-20.

article.conclusion: Cameron Young leads all tiers as the model's top-ranked player. Hideki Matsuyama follows as the second outright and top-5 target. Ryo Hisatsune rounds out the card as the third-ranked top-10/top-20 play.
